concepts.name: TextBook 223 The Early 1970s ZAPU And ZA
concepts.simple_definition: TextBook 223 the early 1970s ZAPU and ZANU had sporadically organized raids into Rhodesia, but in December 1972 the violence of the conflict intensified after a ZANU attack in the northeast
concepts.deep_explanation: The Zambia-Rhodesia border was closed in 1973, but Mozambican inde- pendence in 1975 provided a valuable base of operations for ZANU, which had close links to the FRELIMO government

concepts.name: 224 Grade 12 The Government That Was Set
concepts.simple_definition: 224 Grade 12 The government that was set up by Afrikaner National Party had further strength- ened a system of segregation that was imposed on the majority black population for four decades in South Africa
concepts.deep_explanation: The government came up with extremely racist rules and regulations to guarantee the superiority of the white race in South Africa at the expense of the majority black population of the country
